milestones.title: M0 — Problem Validation
milestones.description: Traceable landlord and tenant evidence; explicit counterevidence and unknowns.

milestones.title: M1 — Modu Startup 2 Submission
milestones.description: Operator target 2026-09-17; official deadline TO VERIFY. GitHub stores this as a date, not an official cutoff time. Final release requires the submission gate.

milestones.title: M2 — MVP Definition
milestones.description: Bounded scope, acceptance criteria, safety and privacy requirements.

milestones.title: M3 — MVP Prototype
milestones.description: Synthetic-data prototype and observed evaluation; no production readiness assumed.

milestones.title: M4 — Pilot
milestones.description: Authorized recruitment, consent, human escalation, and pricing-learning plan.

issues.title: Verify official Modu Startup 2 requirements
acceptance: Locate the current official call and amendments; record source URL, date, and exact locator in SRC-002.
Verify eligibility, deadline/timezone, stage, mandatory fields and limits, attachments, image rules, and evaluation criteria.
Resolve CLM-005; distinguish the internal September 17 target from the official deadline.

issues.title: Build landlord problem evidence
issues.deliverable: research/ substantive landlord evidence note and claim registry
acceptance: Use permissioned recent-event research and primary evidence to test CLM-003.
Record actual observations, counterexamples, sampling limits, and source locators.
Publish only reviewed anonymized summaries; no invented interview outcomes.

issues.title: Build tenant problem evidence
issues.deliverable: research/ substantive tenant evidence note and claim registry
acceptance: Test CLM-004 through authorized research about recent reporting experiences.
Separate recalled events from opinions and concept-test behavior.
Document contrary evidence and privacy review before publishing.

issues.title: Map Korean competitors
acceptance: Reverify candidate organizations and current primary pages.
Compare intake, triage, dashboard, history, and customer segment with exact locators.
Separate vendor claims from tested behavior; UNKNOWN is not feature absence.

issues.title: Research international precedents
acceptance: Verify primary-source descriptions and current availability.
Record workflow patterns, geographic limitations, and transfer hypotheses for Korea.
Avoid unsupported uniqueness, adoption, or feature claims.

issues.title: Validate technical feasibility
issues.deliverable: product/ feasibility decision and synthetic evaluation plan
acceptance: Evaluate text and optional media structuring, uncertainty, and Safety Gate routing.
Define alternatives, cost measurement method, privacy/access boundaries, and failure behavior.
Use free local or already authorized capabilities; paid APIs remain outside authorization.

issues.title: Review legal and safety boundaries
acceptance: Verify applicable current primary legal and official safety sources without asserting legal conclusions.
Cover human escalation, no liability determination, no definitive hazardous-system diagnosis, and no dangerous DIY.
Review consent, minimization, retention, access, and media handling; leave expert review gaps explicit.

issues.title: Design landlord interviews
acceptance: Review the bootstrap guide for neutral recent-event questions and disconfirming cases.
Define recruitment, segment coverage, consent, private storage, and analysis method.
Do not mark interviews conducted merely because the guide exists.

issues.title: Design tenant interviews
acceptance: Review the bootstrap guide and distinguish real experience from hypothetical preference.
Define authorized recruitment, privacy, consent, and stop conditions for safety concerns.
Define synthesis and sample limitations before collecting data.

issues.title: Define MVP scope
acceptance: Validate the four approved modules against evidence and feasibility.
Set observable acceptance criteria, exclusions, state transitions, and access boundaries.
Record unresolved choices without inventing a selected technology stack.

issues.title: Draft 1R application
acceptance: Map draft sections to verified official fields and calculate actual limits.
Use approved product definitions and evidence-linked claims; label gaps.
Keep draft separate from final and do not submit automatically.

issues.title: Build submission claim registry
acceptance: Map every proposed factual application claim to atomic claim/source IDs and exact locators.
Review dates, denominators, scope, contradictions, and publication rights.
Block unsupported market, pricing, willingness-to-pay, traction, and impact figures.

issues.title: Plan submission images
acceptance: Verify official count, dimension, format, file-size, and AI-image rules.
Plan original workflow and synthetic-screen illustrations linked to supported claims.
Label concepts honestly; review rights, accessibility, and personal-data exposure.

issues.title: Run final submission gate
acceptance: Pass all official compliance, evidence, privacy, rights, safety, and file validation checks.
Freeze only an explicitly approved artifact with version, hash, and reviewer record.
Keep gate BLOCKED when requirements or supporting evidence are missing; claim submitted only with a real receipt.

issues.title: Define clickable prototype
acceptance: Define tenant-to-manager flow using clearly synthetic issue and unit identifiers.
Include urgent-case interruption, missing information, handoff, closure, and reopen states.
Choose a platform only after capabilities and permissions are understood.

issues.title: Build AI guided intake prototype
issues.deliverable: Prototype implementation and reproducible synthetic demonstration
acceptance: Implement the bounded intake schema and confirmation step.
Test uncertain input, malicious instructions in media/text, urgent hazards, and failed processing.
Record observed results; do not use real tenant records or unapproved paid APIs.

issues.title: Build triage evaluation dataset
issues.deliverable: Synthetic labeled evaluation cases and evaluation protocol
acceptance: Cover ordinary issues, ambiguous inputs, each listed emergency signal, and conflicting evidence.
Record label rationale, reviewer, provenance, train/evaluation separation, and disagreement handling.
Define safety false-negative and abstention metrics before evaluation; do not invent scores.

issues.title: Recruit first landlord pilot
issues.deliverable: Permissioned pilot plan and anonymized recruitment status
acceptance: Obtain authorization before outreach; keep contact records private.
Confirm segment fit, consent, human escalation, access isolation, and exit/deletion process.
Record a pilot only after actual agreement; no fictional users.

issues.title: Design pricing validation
issues.deliverable: Neutral pricing research protocol linked to CLM-007
acceptance: Separate problem evidence, stated preferences, and actual purchase behavior.
Define customer decision-maker, alternatives, method, and bias controls without assuming price points.
Report willingness to pay only after evidence and limitations are recorded.
